source: Cached high-fidelity get_design_context JSX and previously downloaded original 428x926 reference PNGs; screenshots were inspected and never used as UI images

Artwork and all original static images/SVGs
NewsSession/appendArticleComment; added immutable owned-comment deletion helper
layout: Normal responsive flow for hero, headers, comment cards, composer and two-column topics grid
Comment cards have a 95px minimum height and grow for long text/replies; 500-character unbroken text verified at 320px
The shared page uses KeyboardAvoidingView on iOS; physical keyboard/safe-area QA remains unverified
Editor expands on focus and stays expanded until successful send, so blur does not move the send button before pointer-up
codeConnect: Neither cached context contains a CodeConnectSnippet; no connected component was bypassed
intentionalDemoDifferences: Discussion preview shows three actual sample comments, not the design hardcoded fifty. Topic counts derive from twelve fixtures rather than design placeholders 12/18/24/9/15.
Preview discussion has isolated comments/likes; posting and sorting do not update provider state. Real discussion retains existing article-specific state.
Real comments show reply/delete controls and an editor counter; preview omits those additional controls for the source composition. Only owned comments can be deleted; replies are kept and detached.
The topic preview hides extra follow/back controls; normal UI exposes them and saves follow choices locally. Topic links open real filtered data.
Tái chế maps to Phân loại; Sống xanh maps to Lối sống. The featured ocean card opens the Môi trường feed.
The preview headline/category follow the design variant; normal discussion uses current article title/category with a demo label.
The article/hero photos are original asset exports, not a factual assertion about the people or events in the demo
